name: Swoop Hunting
summary: Harken Windtotem asks you to track swoops across Mulgore. Their quills test patience, cleverness, and marksmanship, and honor the trials of the Earth Mother.

sections.title: A Test of Keen Eyes
sections.body: Across Mulgore's open grasslands, swoops test a hunter's eye. These large birds blend into sky and plain, wheeling overhead or skimming low through tall grass. They demand focus and swift feet, unlike lumbering plainstriders or grazing kodo. Young hunters pursue them to prove their skill and earn standing among the tribes.

sections.title: Badges of the Hunt
sections.body: Harken Windtotem asks for trophy quills to teach discipline, not to cull wildlife. Tauren carry tokens from a hard-won stalk as signs of cleverness and perseverance. Unblemished quills presented to the elders in Bloodhoof Village show a hunter can sustain and defend the community. Swift hooves and sharp senses prepare them for the wider world.

faq.q: What is the purpose of hunting swoops for Harken Windtotem?
faq.answer: Harken Windtotem asks you to track swoops across Mulgore and test your cleverness, speed, and dedication. Intact trophy quills show your skill and bring honor among the tauren of Bloodhoof Village.
Swoops roam Mulgore's open plains, soaring above the grass or searching for prey beyond settlements such as Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Why are swoops considered tricky to hunt?
aliases: why are swoops hard to catch
faq.answer: Swoops are swift, alert predators spread across the plains. You need sharp eyes to spot them and quick strides to catch them before they escape.

faq.q: What do the trophy quills signify to the tauren?
faq.answer: Trophy swoop quills represent patience, sharp vision, and a successful hunt. They show you have the instincts to provide for and protect the tribe.
Harken Windtotem is a respected tauren of Bloodhoof Village. He watches newcomers and aspiring hunters, judging their resourcefulness through traditional trials across the plains.

faq.q: Does this hunt impact the balance of nature in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The tauren treat hunting as a sacred exchange with the Earth Mother, not wanton slaughter. Gathering quills tests discipline and honors clever prey while sustaining the tribe's balance.

angles.text: As a tauren, hunting Mulgore's swift swoops is a rite of passage. It sharpens your tracking and upholds ancestral customs.
As a hunter, tracking swoops teaches you to follow flying prey, read its behavior, and strike with precision against alert predators.
As a druid, tracking swoops across Mulgore's mesas brings you closer to the predatory birds that help balance its skies.
